articles.title_en: “Downs's Law” under the lens of theory: Roads lower congestion and increase distance traveled
articles.title_cn: 理论视角下的“唐斯定律”：道路降低拥堵并增加行驶距离
articles.abstract_en: Downs (1962) claimed a “Law”: that expressways lower congestion even though they reach maximum traffic flow. In urban economics since Strotz (1965), road capacity is measured by road width, and congestion as the delay in travel: wider roads lower congestion. Duranton and Turner (2011), in an econometric study, atypically defined congestion, not as delay in travel, but as aggregate vehicle kilometers traveled (VKT) relative to the aggregate length of roads, concluding that roads are unlikely to relieve congestion. We first provide the theory behind “Downs's Law”. Then, in a series of theoretical models, we endogenize rent, income, the value of time, leisure, Marshallian productivity, consumption-linked trips, road costs, spatial detail, and a suburb-to-city expressway competing with existing roads. In each case we prove that adding more road capacity lowers congestion and increases utility in the short run when city population is fixed; and lowers congestion in the long run too despite induced travel or population growth. Aggregate travel cost and VKT rise or fall, depending on how much congestion is lowered, on the cost elasticity of travel demand, on location-based income and substitution effects, and on which roads are widened.
articles.abstract_cn: 唐斯（1962）提出了一条“定律”：高速公路即使达到最大交通流量，也会降低拥堵。自斯特罗茨（1965）以来的城市经济学中，道路容量以道路宽度衡量，拥堵则表现为出行延误：更宽的道路降低拥堵。杜兰顿和特纳（2011）在一项计量经济学研究中，非典型地将拥堵定义为相对于道路总长度的总车辆行驶公里数（VKT），而非出行延误，并得出结论认为道路不太可能缓解拥堵。我们首先提供“唐斯定律”背后的理论。然后，在一系列理论模型中，我们将租金、收入、时间价值、闲暇、马歇尔生产率、与消费相关的出行、道路成本、空间细节以及一条与现有道路竞争的郊区至城市高速公路内生化。在每种情况下，我们证明，在城市人口固定的短期内，增加更多道路容量会降低拥堵并提高效用；并且在长期内也会降低拥堵，尽管存在诱发的出行或人口增长。总出行成本和VKT的升降取决于拥堵降低的程度、出行需求的成本弹性、基于位置的收入和替代效应，以及哪些道路被拓宽。

articles.title_en: Volatility in Home Sales and Prices: Supply or Demand?
articles.title_cn: 房屋销售与价格的波动：供给还是需求？
articles.abstract_en: We use a housing search model and data on individual home listings to decompose short-run fluctuations in home sales and price growth into supply or demand factors, defined as the number of new sellers and buyers entering the housing market, respectively. We find that fluctuations in the number of buyers demanding homes explain much more of the variation in home sales and price growth than do fluctuations in the supply of homes for sale. In our preferred paramaterization, fluctuations in demand explain essentially all of the variation in home sales, and most of the variation in prices. We consider two implications of these results. First, we show that reduction of supply was a minor factor relative to an increased number of buyers in the tightening of housing markets during COVID-19. New for-sale listings would have had to expand 30 percent to keep the rate of price growth at pre-pandemic levels given the pandemic-era surge in demand. Second, we estimate that the number of buyers demanding homes is very sensitive to changes in mortgage rates, even more so than comparable estimates for home sales, suggesting that policies that affect housing demand through mortgage rates can influence housing market dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用住房搜索模型和个体房屋挂牌数据，将房屋销售和价格增长的短期波动分解为供给或需求因素，分别定义为进入住房市场的新卖家和买家数量。我们发现，买家需求数量的波动对房屋销售和价格增长变化的解释程度远高于待售房屋供给的波动。在我们偏好的参数化设定下，需求波动几乎解释了房屋销售的全部变化，以及价格的大部分变化。我们考虑了这些结果的两个含义。首先，我们表明，在COVID-19期间，相对于买家数量的增加，供给减少是住房市场收紧的一个次要因素。鉴于疫情时期需求的激增，新的待售挂牌量需要扩大30%才能将价格增长率保持在疫情前水平。其次，我们估计，购房需求对抵押贷款利率的变化非常敏感，甚至比房屋销售的类似估计更为敏感，这表明通过抵押贷款利率影响住房需求的政策可以影响住房市场动态。

articles.title_en: On the economic impacts of mortgage credit expansion policies: Evidence from help to buy
articles.title_cn: 论抵押信贷扩张政策的经济影响：来自“购房援助”计划的证据
articles.abstract_en: We take advantage of two spatial discontinuities in Britain's Help to Buy (HtB) scheme to explore the effectiveness and distributional implications of mortgage credit expansion policies. Employing a Difference-in-Discontinuities design, we find that HtB significantly increased house prices and had no detectable effect on construction volumes in severely supply constrained and unaffordable Greater London. Conversely, HtB did increase construction numbers without a noticeable effect on prices near the English/Welsh border, an affordable area with comparably lax supply conditions. While HtB did not help would-be-buyers in already unaffordable areas, it boosted the financial performance of developers participating in the scheme.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用英国“购房援助”（HtB）计划中的两个空间不连续性来探讨抵押信贷扩张政策的有效性和分配影响。采用断点回归中的差分设计，我们发现HtB显著提高了房价，且在供应严重受限且房价难以负担的大伦敦地区，对建筑量没有可检测的影响。相反，在英格兰/威尔士边境附近，一个供应条件相对宽松的可负担地区，HtB确实增加了建筑数量，而对价格没有显著影响。虽然HtB并未帮助本已负担不起地区的潜在购房者，但它提升了参与该计划的开发商的财务表现。

articles.title_en: Making their own weather? Estimating employer labour-market power and its wage effects
articles.title_cn: 自造天气？估算雇主劳动力市场势力及其工资效应
articles.abstract_en: The subdued wage growth observed in many countries has spurred interest in monopsony views of regional labour markets. This study measures the extent and robustness of employer power and its wage implications exploiting comprehensive matched employer–employee data. We find average (employment-weighted) Herfindhal indices of 800 to 1,100, stable over the 1986–2019 period covered, and that typically less than 8% of workers are exposed to concentration levels thought to raise market power concerns. When controlling for both worker and firm heterogeneity and instrumenting for concentration, we find that wages are negatively affected by employer concentration, with elasticities of around −1.4%. We also find that several methodological choices can change significantly both the measurement of concentration and its wage effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多国家观察到的工资增长乏力引发了对区域劳动力市场买方垄断观点的兴趣。本研究利用全面的匹配雇主-雇员数据，衡量雇主势力及其工资影响的程度和稳健性。我们发现平均（就业加权）赫芬达尔指数为800至1,100，在覆盖的1986-2019期间保持稳定，且通常不到8%的工人面临被认为引发市场势力担忧的集中度水平。在控制工人和企业异质性并对集中度进行工具变量处理后，我们发现工资受到雇主集中度的负面影响，弹性约为−1.4%。我们还发现，若干方法论选择可能显著改变集中度及其工资效应的测量。

articles.title_en: The marginal cost of mortality risk reduction: Evidence from housing markets
articles.title_cn: 死亡率风险降低的边际成本：来自住房市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: We provide the first evidence on the rate at which spatial variation in all-cause mortality risk is capitalized into US housing prices. Using a hedonic framework, we recover the annual implicit cost of a 0.1 percentage-point reduction in mortality risk among older Americans and find that this cost is less than $3453 for a 67 year old and decreasing with age to less than $629 for an 87 year old. These estimates, while similar to estimates from the market for health care, are far below comparable estimates from markets for labor and automobiles, suggesting that the housing market provides an alternative, substantially cheaper channel for reducing mortality risk. We find this conclusion to be robust to a wide range of econometric model specifications, including accounting for associated expenditures on property taxes and the physical and financial costs of moving.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于全因死亡率风险的空间变化在美国住房价格中资本化比率的首个证据。利用特征价格框架，我们恢复了老年人中死亡率风险降低0.1个百分点所对应的年度隐性成本，发现对于67岁的人来说，这一成本低于3453美元，并随着年龄增长而下降，对于87岁的人来说，低于629美元。这些估计虽然与医疗保健市场的估计相似，但远低于劳动力和汽车市场的可比估计，表明住房市场为降低死亡率风险提供了一个替代性的、成本更低的渠道。我们发现这一结论在广泛的计量经济学模型设定下都是稳健的，包括考虑房产税的相关支出以及搬迁的物理和财务成本。

articles.title_en: Pandemics and cities: Evidence from the Black Death and the long-run
articles.title_cn: 流行病与城市：来自黑死病及其长期影响的证据
articles.abstract_en: The Black Death killed 40% of Europe’s population between 1347 and 1352, making it one of the largest shocks in the history of mankind. Using a novel dataset that provides information on spatial variation in plague mortality at the city level, as well as various identification strategies, we explore the short-run and long-run impacts of Black Death mortality on city growth. On average, cities recovered their pre-plague populations within two centuries. However, aggregate convergence masked heterogeneity in urban recovery. Both of these facts are consistent with populations returning disproportionally to locations endowed with more rural and urban fixed factors of production. Land suitability and natural and historical trade networks played a vital role in recovery. Our study highlights the role played by the Black Death and physical and economic geography in determining the relative size of European cities.
articles.abstract_cn: 黑死病在1347年至1352年间杀死了欧洲40%的人口，成为人类历史上最大的冲击之一。利用一个提供城市层面鼠疫死亡率空间变异信息的新数据集，以及多种识别策略，我们探讨了黑死病死亡率对城市增长的短期和长期影响。平均而言，城市在两个世纪内恢复了瘟疫前的人口水平。然而，总体趋同掩盖了城市恢复的异质性。这两个事实都与人口不成比例地回流到拥有更多农村和城市固定生产要素的地区相一致。土地适宜性以及自然和历史贸易网络在恢复中发挥了至关重要的作用。我们的研究强调了黑死病以及自然和经济地理在决定欧洲城市相对规模中所起的作用。

articles.title_en: Collaboration and connectivity: Historical evidence from patent records
articles.title_cn: 合作与连通性：来自专利记录的历史证据
articles.abstract_en: Why has collaboration become increasingly central to technological progress? We document the role of lowered travel costs by combining patent data with the rollout of the Swedish railroad network in the 19th and early-20th century. Inventors that gain access to the network are more likely to produce collaborative patents, which is partly driven by long-distance collaborations with other inventors residing along the emerging railroad network. These results suggest that the declining costs of interacting with others is fundamental to account for the long-term increase in inventive collaboration.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么合作在技术进步中变得越来越核心？我们通过将专利数据与19世纪及20世纪初瑞典铁路网络的扩展相结合，记录了旅行成本降低的作用。获得铁路网络接入的发明人更有可能产出合作专利，这部分是由与新兴铁路网络沿线其他发明人的长途合作所驱动的。这些结果表明，与他人互动成本的下降对于解释发明合作长期增长至关重要。
